verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ROS 2 is described as spanning "drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms" (ros2-gh-1) and that it standardizes complex robotics datatypes across libraries (ros2-comm-16), plus generic pub/sub topics for continuous data streams (ros2-docs-10, ros2-docs-20) which fit sensor streaming use cases. However, there is no concrete evidence in the pack of specific ready-made drivers or standard message packages for cameras, lidars, IMUs, or GPS (e.g., sensor_msgs, camera_info, driver packages). missing for 10: explicit driver package listings for camera/lidar/IMU/GPS hardware, evidence of sensor_msgs or similar standard message definitions, and any hands-on confirmation of sensor bring-up workflow.
